title: The Trail Beyond
description: Rod Drew (John Wayne) is asked to search for missing people in Canada, and quickly finds out a gang of French Canadian outlaws have been kidnapping people.

title: The Lucky Texan
description: Jerry Mason (John Wayne) and his friend Jake (George Hayes) have to keep two crooks away from their gold.

title: Riders of the Deadline
description: Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) and his pals (Andy Clyde, Jimmy Rogers) get the drop on Mexican-border gunrunners.

title: The Kansan
description: The new marshal (Richard Dix) of a Kansas town cracks down on his sponsor, a greedy banker (Albert Dekker).

title: The Painted Desert
description: A tungsten miner (Bill Boyd) loves his father's rival's daughter (Helen Twelvetrees) and fights off her other suitor (Clark Gable).

title: American Empire
description: Three men (Richard Dix, Leo Carrillo, Preston Foster) start a big cattle ranch in post-Civil War Texas, but greed destroys it.

title: The Gunman From Bodie
description: The Rough Riders (Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, Raymond Hatton) act like strangers to catch a crooked lawyer.

title: Fighting Fury
description: A boy raised by his servant vows to take revenge on the ranchers who killed his parents.

title: The Diamond Trail
description: A New York reporter (Rex Bell) follows a gang of gem smugglers west.

title: With Sitting Bull at the Spirit Lake Massacre
description: Chief Sitting Bull surveys the settlement at Spirit Lake from afar and vows to retake the land that once belonged to his forefathers.

title: Cowboy G-Men
description:
S01 E13 — Ghost Bushwacker
Pat Gallagher and his sidekick Stoney Crockett are Secret Service agents in the Old West, dispatched by the government to investigate crimes threatening the young nation. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan.

title: Cowboy G-Men
description:
S01 E39 — California Bullets
Gold is stolen from a US government mint; Pat and Stoney are on the case.

title: Cowboy G-Men
description:
S01 E01 — Ozark Gold
Pat & Stoney seek missing government gold hidden in Ozarks.

title: Cowboy G-Men
description:
S01 E02 — Chinaman's Chance
Outlaw gangs are stealing gold from Chinese miners and driving them off of their claims.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:
S01 E21 — The Very Old Antique
Railroad executive Homer Bedloe arrives in Hooterville with a railroad tycoon, who is determined to purchase the Cannonball.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:
S01 E01 — Spur Line to Shady Rest
A man travels to Hooterville to investigate a line connection.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:
S01 E02 — Quick, Hide the Railroad
Kate wants to hide the Hooterville Cannonball to save it from the scrap heap.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:
S01 E03 — The President Who Came to Dinner
The railroad president decides to scrap the Cannonball himself.

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S02 E15 — Sure-Shot Annie
Annie (Gail Davis) attempts to prove a beautiful woman (Eve Miller) is involved in two bank robberies. With Rick Vallin.

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S02 E17 — The Troubleshooter
An outlaw keeps his convict brother from going straight.

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S02 E20 — Powder Rock Stampede
Annie (Gail Davis) has hopes of acquiring a prime piece of land in a newly opened territory. With Douglas Kennedy, James Griffith.

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S03 E04 — Annie and the Twisted Trails
Annie (Gail Davis) becomes involved in a controversy between a teen (Carolyn Craig) and her overly possessive father (Ewing Mitchell).

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S03 E05 — The Robin Hood Kid
Annie (Gail Davis) and Lofty (Brad Johnson) try to discover the identity of a masked man known as the Robin Hood Kid (Tyler MacDuff).

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S03 E09 — Indian Justice
Annie (Gail Davis) and Lofty (Brad Johnson) step in when a young cavalry officer (Harry Lauter) is framed for murder.

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S03 E10 — Showdown at Diablo
Lofty (Brad Johnson) faces a moral dilemma when confronted with a notorious outlaw who once saved his life. With Lane Bradford, Bill Henry.

title: Annie Oakley
description:
S03 E12 — Renegade's Return
A notorious outlaw arrives during an election to shed a bad light on his brother, an honest lawyer running for office.

title: Young Buffalo Bill
description: Buffalo Bill (Roy Rogers) and the cavalry protect mining surveyors from Indians in New Mexico.

title: Boots and Saddles
description: A singing ranch foreman and his sidekick convince a young British nobleman to keep, rather than sell, the ranch left to him by his late father.

title: The Way of the West
description: A Mountie moves to a town and begins to stop its illegal activity by busting people one by one.

title: The Lawless Frontier
description: A cowboy (John Wayne) protects a girl (Sheila Terry) and her father (George Hayes) from a rustler and a sheriff.

title: Blue Steel
description: Marshal John Carruthers helps a sheriff find out who stole the town's payroll, and together they discover the town's leader stole the money to buy up all the land.

title: Between Men
description: A blacksmith's son (Johnny Mack Brown) goes to New Mexico to find his benefactor's (William Farnum) disinherited granddaughter (Beth Marion).

title: Fighting Westerner
description: Heirs of a radium mine owner face murder attempts. A mining engineer investigates to find the killer and prove his cousin's innocence. The mine's value motivates the crimes.

title: In Old Colorado
description: Hopalong Cassidy stops Joe Weiler from instigating a prairie war between two ranchers.

title: Colorado Kid
description: A cowboy (Bob Steele) framed for murder breaks out of jail to prove his innocence.

title: Riders of the Whistling Pines
description: Outlaw lumbermen frame a singing cowboy (Gene Autry) ; his friend (Jimmy Lloyd) saves him with a plane.

title: Broadway to Cheyenne
description: A New York police officer, shot and wounded by a gangster, travels to Cheyenne, Wyo., to recuperate at his family's ranch, and is surprised to find a bootlegger from New York running a speakeasy there.

title: Raiders of the Border
description: U.S. marshals (Johnny Mack Brown, Raymond Hatton) catch rustlers swapping cattle for Mexican jewels.

title: Fugitive of the Plains
description: Billy the Kid (Buster Crabbe) stages a shootout with outlaws who have transformed an innocent young lady into a wanted desperado.

title: Revenge of the Virgins
description: When white settlers start to move in on their sacred grounds, a tribe of female Indians vow to do anything they can to stop them.

title: Young Bill Hickok
description: The frontier hero (Roy Rogers) sings and saves Civil War gold with his sidekick (George "Gabby" Hayes).

title: Cowboy G-Men
description:
S01 E03 — The Golden Wolf
Pat and Stoney hunt a legendary golden wolf that roams the Colorado foothills.

title: Cowboy G-Men
description:
S01 E04 — Secret Mission
While in Wyoming to oversee a land deal, Pat and Stoney take care of a pair of twins.

title: Cowboy G-Men
description:
S01 E05 — Chippewa Indians
The agents go to Wisconsin to investigate an Indian agent's claim.

title: Cowboy G-Men
description:
S01 E06 — Center Fire
Pat and Stoney go to California to investigate reports of an anthrax epidemic.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:
S01 E04 — Is There a Doctor in the Roundhouse?
Curtis breaks the throttle of the Cannonball and blocks the way to Kate's jamboree.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:
S01 E05 — The Courtship of Floyd Smoot
Kate tries to restore the self-confidence of Floyd Smoot after he is jilted by his mail-order sweetheart, by pretending to be in love with him.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:
S01 E06 — Please Buy My Violets
Uncle Joe decides to go into the cologne business.

title: Petticoat Junction
description:
S01 E07 — The Ringer
Betty Jo becomes the first female contestant in the horseshoe tournament.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E34 — Border Raiders
Mr. Kenyon and his children come across a cache of gunpowder in an abandoned cabin.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E17 — Checkmate
Doc resorts to extreme measures to fund his free public clinic.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E10 — Citizen Romeo
The judge learns of a scheme to smuggle guns and ammo to the Indians and finds a way to break it up.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E35 — The Cross-Draw Kid
Judge Roy Bean endeavors to exact justice in the small town of Langtry in the Old West. In this episode, the Judge and Jeff take on the richest man in the valley over water rights.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E30 — The Defense Rests
Jeff Taggert's brother is accused of robbing the Del Rio bank; while investigating the case, Jeff becomes implicated in the hold-up.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E31 — Deliver the Body
Sheriff Blade arrives from Comstock to arrest rancher Del Randall on what appears to the Judge to be trumped-up charges; Bean and Taggart put Del in jail for safety while they investigate.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E18 — Desperate Journey
A young man is accused of murder; he makes a run for it.

title: Judge Roy Bean
description:
S01 E27 — The Elopers
Sharon Bender's father is killed when her intentions to marry Adam over his objections are known.

title: Daniel Boone, Trail Blazer
description: The frontiersman (Bruce Bennett) leads settlers to Kentucky, where he makes peace with a Shawnee chief (Lon Chaney).

title: Cry Blood, Apache
description: An old man (Joel McCrea) recalls his days as a young man (Jody McCrea) fighting Indians in the Old West.

title: The Man From Utah
description: A tough cowboy has a head-to-head confrontation with a gang of outlaws using a rodeo as its base of operations.

title: The Courageous Avenger
description: A law officer tries to bring a traitorous mine foreman to justice.

title: The Dawn Rider
description: A cowboy (John Wayne) romances a pretty woman (Marion Burns) while tracking the outlaw gang that killed his father.

title: High Lonesome
description: Texas ranchers blame a homeless drifter (John Barrymore Jr.) for two killers' dirty work.

title: Range War
description: Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) and sidekick Lucky (Russell Hayden) help a railroad man (Matt Moore) thwart a land baron.

title: Santa Fe Trail
description: Jeb Stuart and George Custer get stationed at Fort Leavenworth in Kansas and work together to stop abolitionist John Brown.

title: Bulldog Courage
description: A young man, out to avenge his father's murder, prompts speedy action from the law.

title: Stagecoach to Denver
description: Red Ryder uncovers a land-grabbing scheme engineered by a supposedly respected member of the community.

title: Arizona Thunderbolt
description: A circus performer (Joe Cook) and his piano-playing partner (Robert Cummings) go after a pair of ruthless rustlers.

title: Hellgate
description: After the Civil War, ranch owner Gil Hanley helps a stranger in desperate need of medical attention. Soon he is questioned by Union soldiers about the stranger, who turns out to be an ex-Confederate soldier.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E17 — Dog Story
A dog leads Cisco and Pancho to his murdered master's gold mine where they become trapped by the victim's killers.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E18 — Confession for Money
Cisco proves that the man being held in jail on a murder charge is not the actual murderer.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E19 — The Old Bum
A respectable businessman traps an elderly man into a rustling ring scheme that Pancho and Cisco later discover.

title: The Cisco Kid
description:
S01 E20 — Haven for Heavies
Cisco and Pancho set out to prove that a notorious outlaw has murdered a U.S. marshal.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E15 — Chief Crazy Horse
Matt enlists the aid of Dakota chiefs to bring in Crazy Horse.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E16 — Black Bart
The man behind a string of stagecoach robberies has remained out of reach of company detectives Matt and Frankie, but reinforcements from the city help to crack the case.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E17 — Henry Plummer
Elected as mayor, an outlaw deputizes members of his gang.

title: Stories of the Century
description:
S01 E18 — Bill Longley
A killer escapes from prison and tries to reunite with his girlfriend.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E05 — The Hopefuls
Outlaws plot to steal a trunk containing the savings of a religious group heading for a new life in the West.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E06 — Denver McKee
The Cartwrights' neighbor (Franchot Tone), a former soldier and lawman, seeks security for his daughter.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E07 — Day of Reckoning
Bigoted Ike Daggett takes action when Ben gives an Indian and his wife land after the Indian saves his life.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E08 — The Abduction
Hoss and Little Joe spend the most unforgettable night at the carnival when Little Joe's date disappears.

title: Wildfire
description: Two horse-traders (Bob Steele, Sterling Holloway) find their problem is a rustler (John Miljan), not a wild horse.

title: Enemy of the Law
description: Former Texas Ranger Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), now an attorney, is called back into law enforcement by his old pals Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and Panhandle Perkins (Guy Wilkerson), who want his help recovering some stolen gold.

title: Shine on Harvest Moon
description: Former partner Milt Brower (William Farnum) and Pa Jackson (Stanley Andrews) are engaged in an embittered land dispute that turns ugly when Jackson accuses Brower of the dastardly crime of cattle rustling.

title: McLintock!
description: A cattle baron (John Wayne) tries to tame his wife (Maureen O'Hara) amid a feud with settlers and trouble with Indians.

title: Winds of the Wasteland
description: Two former Pony Express riders enter a dilapidated stagecoach in a race for a government mail contract.

title: Doomed Caravan
description: Hopalong Cassidy rides shotgun for a freight company and comes up against a gang of outlaws posing as cavalrymen.

title: Outpost in Morocco
description: A French Foreign Legion captain (George Raft) loves an enemy Arab chieftain's daughter (Marie Windsor).

title: Adventures of Gallant Bess
description: A rodeo stunt rider (Cameron Mitchell) meets a woman (Audrey Long) who comes between him and his trick horse, Bess.

title: Sitting Bull
description: President Grant helps a cavalry major (Dale Robertson) condemned for helping Dakota Chief Sitting Bull (J. Carrol Naish).

title: The Dude Ranger
description: An Easterner (George O'Brien) finds rustlers and a sweetheart (Irene Hervey) on the ranch he inherited out West.

title: Hit the Saddle
description: The Three Mesquiteers (Robert Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune) discover a painted horse and a fandango dancer.

title: Phantom Ranger
description: A federal investigator (Tim McCoy) poses as an outlaw to catch a gang of counterfeiters which has kidnapped a government engraver.
